notifications.title: EUV long video: three thumbnails ready for Test & Compare
notifications.detail: L-20261124-21 'How Does ASML's EUV Machine Print a Chip With Light?' ships with thumbnail B ('Printed by plasma', the glowing wafer struck by a beam, 9/10) as the pick, plus A ('No lenses', the machine cut open, 8/10) and C ('Tin to chip', 8/10). QA would click C, then B. YouTube's Test & Compare has no API, so only you can run it.
notifications.fix: 1. After it is published, open the video in YouTube Studio. 2. Details -> Thumbnail -> Test & compare. 3. Upload thumbnail-b.png, thumbnail.png and thumbnail-c.png from channels/how-tech-and-ai-actually-work-chips-ai-p/videos/L-20261124-21/.
